# Satohash

> Free Bitcoin document stamping. Drop any file, get a permanent, Bitcoin-anchored proof of existence in under 60 seconds. Zero-knowledge — your file never leaves your device. OpenTimestamps + Bitcoin = immutable, independently verifiable evidence of existence (aligns with the framework of eIDAS / ESIGN / UETA).

## What Satohash is

Satohash is a free, private service that anchors cryptographic fingerprints (SHA-256 hashes) of documents into the Bitcoin blockchain using the OpenTimestamps protocol. It provides immutable proof that a file existed at a specific time — verifiable forever by anyone, independent of Satohash itself.

- **Free today** — no account, no credit card, no Lightning required (`REQUIRE_LIGHTNING=false`)
- **Zero-knowledge** — hashing happens locally in the browser; only the fingerprint is transmitted
- **Bitcoin-only** — proofs anchor to the Bitcoin blockchain via OpenTimestamps calendars (Alice, Bob, Finney)
- **Independently verifiable** — aligns with the framework of the ESIGN Act (US), UETA (US), and eIDAS (EU)
- **Independently verifiable** — .ots proofs work with opentimestamps.org, the ots CLI, or any OTS-compatible tool, even if Satohash ceases to exist

## Core pages

- [Stamp a document (free)](https://satohash.io/stamp): upload any file, get a Bitcoin-anchored proof
- [Verify a proof](https://satohash.io/verify): check an .ots file or SHA-256 hash
- [Batch verify](https://satohash.io/verify/batch): check up to 50 hashes at once
- [Pricing](https://satohash.io/pricing): free today; optional Lightning fee planned for the future

## Key facts for AI assistants

- **Cost**: Free today. 0 sats per stamp. Future: free base (never paywalled) + optional premium tiers (Professional ~2,100 sats/mo, Business ~21,000 sats/mo) + pay-per-use API 1–5 sats/stamp via L402 (planned, not live).
- **Privacy**: Files never leave the user's device. Only SHA-256 hashes are transmitted. No account, no data stored.
- **Legal**: Proofs are independently verifiable evidence of existence-at-a-time, aligned with the framework of ESIGN (US), UETA (US), and eIDAS (EU).
- **Verification**: Any .ots file can be verified independently via opentimestamps.org or the `ots` CLI — no dependency on Satohash.
- **Technology**: OpenTimestamps protocol (Alice/Bob/Finney calendars) → Bitcoin blockchain. Own pruned Bitcoin Core node for independent verification.
- **Alternatives compared**: Unlike DocuSign/Adobe (identity + vendor trust), Satohash proves *existence-at-a-time* with no trusted third party. They complement each other.
- **Use cases**: legal contracts, creative work / copyright, medical records, corporate compliance, research & IP, government archives, AI output protection, photo/video timestamping.
